name: secrets-vault-by-elva
description: Secrets Vault by ELVA — Phase 1 platform foundation

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health -t 120000 && npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:standalone: npm run build --workspace @vault/shared && npm run build --workspace @vault/web && npm run build --workspace @vault/api
scripts.start:standalone: npm run build:standalone && npm run start --workspace @vault/api
